_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Finance extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. bank_failure) + active diagnosis ids (e.g. BANKING_CRISIS) (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). In Finance the CONDITION-CODES (bank_failure, volatility_cascade...) never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger; this table bridges them. NOTE: unlike Energy, Finance activation.diagnosticTriggers ARE diagnosis ids, so active diagnosis ids already self-match; the condition-code map is the part that is strictly required.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(finance-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L185-238)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L53-121 / L250-256)--> diagnosis id --(finance.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are themselves diagnosis ids)--> diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, which is requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, NOT primaryIndicators). A condition that is only a diagnosis secondaryConfirmation but does not emit that diagnosis requiredFamily is listed under secondaryDiagnoses and NOT folded (bias against over-marking).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from finance.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsEnergy: DIFFERENT structure. (1) Energy has a dedicated classify() over a distinct EXOGENOUS-event vocabulary (crude_above_90, grid_stress); Finance inlines classification and its condition-codes ARE the contract indicator tokens (bank_failure, volatility_cascade). (2) Energy activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases; Finance activation.diagnosticTriggers are DIAGNOSIS IDs, so diagnosis ids self-match and the diagnoses map is largely redundant for direct matching. (3) Energy stress catch-all has named codes (energy_high_stress) tied to SYSTEMIC_ENERGY_STRESS; Finance _stress_* conditions are explicitly excluded from all families (L189) and no code feeds its catch-all diagnosis SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION. (4) Finance emits a macro_event family (from macro_shock) that NO contract consumes (dead-end); Energy macro_event was consumed. (5) Orphan count: Energy 1, Finance 3.

conditionCodes.reason: finance-pulse-engine.js classifies macro_shock -> evidence family [macro_event] (L228-230), but NO EVIDENCE_CONTRACT lists macro_event in requiredFamilies. The family is a dead-end: it reaches no diagnosis, hence no _authored circuit, hence no activation. No grounded alias. (Contrast Energy, where macro_shock/macro_event feeds SYSTEMIC_ENERGY_STRESS.)

finance-pulse-engine.js explicitly SKIPS any condition whose name starts with _stress_ (L188-189: must NOT map to any evidence family). These are dynamically-generated stress tokens; they emit no family and are named in no contract, so there is no defensible condition->diagnosis link. The one catch-all-eligible diagnosis (SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION, catchAllBlocked:false) is reached by a diagnosis being externally marked active without evidence (L258-260), NOT by any _stress_ condition-code, so no alias can be grounded here.

activationsWithTriggersButNoTriggerSourc.reason: Activation has diagnosticTriggers but its brainNodeId appears in NO issue._authored circuit (and no condition-code chain reaches it). Under current wiring nothing marks it active, so extinction would ALWAYS list it for retirement. No grounded alias exists; NOT fabricated. Needs authoring into an issue circuit before extinction should touch it. (Finance analog of Energy Data Centers/HYPO orphan; Finance has THREE.)
